game_title: Fallback: Name Tag Match – Blacksmith Row
game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Blacksmith Row, a street of busy forges: the knight must hold off siege rats while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Name Tag Match: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing scrolls before they reach siege rats.
theme: The Kingdom – Blacksmith Row: a street of busy forges
core_gameplay_loop: In Blacksmith Row, repeat each round: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing scrolls before they reach siege rats. Then check tag_matches and advance.
player_objective: Protect the granary door from siege rats in Blacksmith Row: keep tag_matches above zero until the 34-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 5 (applied tier): Name Tag Match
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 1, Level 5, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
